statement: Slow interior pad movements with settled holds support approximate compatibility scales of 128 native coordinate units per right-pad mouse count and 1024 per left-pad scroll count. Right-pad Y and left-pad vertical scroll reverse the native positive-Y sign; horizontal signs follow native positive X. For example right-pad vertical travel of about 13842 units yielded -108 counts; left-pad horizontal travel of about 17054 units yielded +16 counts and vertical travel about 18871 units yielded -19. Uneven movement, contact settling, report phase and rounding prevent an exact firmware transfer-function claim. The first right-pad horizontal center window contained early movement and is not stationary evidence. Fractional accumulation at these scales is a virtual compatibility model, not replay of an established retail filter.

applicability.firmware: Not independently re-read in each action session; no firmware update performed
applicability.scope: Bounded owner-guided windows and normal SDL open/close only; no wireless, watchdog or calibrated transfer function.
